definition: The machinery behind text-to-video: spatiotemporal DiT blocks, temporal attention for motion consistency, and long-clip strategies like autoregressive chunking with overlap.
details: The machinery behind text-to-video: spatiotemporal DiT blocks, temporal attention for motion consistency, and long-clip strategies like autoregressive chunking with overlap. Object permanence and physics remain the visible failure modes, fueling the world-model debate (see World Models).
